name: Gujarat Govt Scheme → Vahali Dikri Yojana

service.description: Vahali Dikri Yojana (Women & Child Development) — help for the first two daughters of a family, paid in parts.
service.depending: Birth certificate of the daughter, Aadhaar Card of the parents, income certificate, ration card, bank passbook
service.rules: Apply within one year of the daughter's birth. Give the acknowledgement to the customer.
